interpretation: The backported runtime matches the shipped v0.6.2 runtime on every lane gate within run-to-run noise: 130,048-token retrieval exact at 2,174.5 tok/s (2,169.9 before), decode 134.15 tok/s wall (132.53), 5.2 GB restore in 3.89/3.86 s (4.00/3.63), fanout medians 1.40/1.52 s (1.40/1.53), tampered restore refused, agent protocol 200/404/404.
The full 102-test suite passed on an ephemeral sm_120a GPU, including every ops kernel suite the perf commits touch and the #42 capacity contract test.

On the documented route the published image pulled by digest served the same identity the launcher computed, the profile gates re-measured exact through the documented tunnel (2,172.5 tok/s), and the macOS client route passed 10 of 10 including a server restart with the session continued.

Independent review: one full council was dispatched on the frozen subject (CR-20260913T1843Z-8818b88b). The cross-family supplement (Grok) completed with zero findings; the strong critic (Daybreak Blue) did not render a verdict because its model selector no longer resolves in the upgraded OMP 18.1.18 harness, and Gemini returned a provider 429. The epoch closed on disposition with no P0/P1 and that residual recorded; the release evidence therefore rests on the lead's verification, one cross-family supplement, the deterministic suite and the complete lane qualification.
